light_description: Croatian handmade distortion with clean-boost through high-gain range, four controls, and broad contour shaping.
Original two-channel gain design pairing an independent drive/distortion channel with a transparent preamp/boost channel.
Redesigned successor to Diktator with revised FET buffering, tube-amp-style drive section, selectable clipping, and transparent boost channel.
Croatian dual-section analog foundation pedal combining British-style overdrive/distortion with EQ and Rangemaster-style or clean boost functions.
Slovenian handmade low-gain overdrive built around classic circuit foundations with custom enclosure and controls.
Slovenian low-gain Bluesbreaker-style overdrive with increased volume, sparkle, and mid presence.
Croatian fuzz-centered multi-effect combining silicon fuzz with bitcrusher and reverb/delay, with later updates adding fuzz gain and delay modes.
